# Release Notes for <mark>STM32G0xx_Nucleo32 Board drivers</mark>
Copyright &copy; 2019 STMicroelectronics\
    
[![ST logo](_htmresc/st_logo_2020.png)](https://www.st.com){.logo}

# Purpose

This driver provides a set of functions to manage:

- LED on STM32G0xx_Nucleo32 Kit from STMicroelectronics
- GRAVITECH 4 digits shield

:::
